0022600177.text: The Bulls (1-6, 13th in the East, on a five-game losing streak) visit the Knicks (3-4, 8th in the East, winners of their last game) in Chicago's eighth game of the season. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, and New York has no players listed as unavailable. New York beat Chicago 133-127 in Chicago on October 28, and the Bulls lost 1-3 to the Knicks in 2025-26.
